title: A client can read another company's order
summary: GET /api/orders/{id} returns 200 with the full order to a user of a different company.
steps: Sign in as acme-1 over the API and POST /api/orders (reference QA-rule-1, one item p-101 x1); note the order id
Sign in as bright-1 (Bright Foods) and GET /api/orders/{that id}
Observe HTTP 200 with Acme Traders' order (see evidence for the curl)
expected: HTTP 403 or 404; companies never see each other's data
suspected_cause: Order detail handler does not compare the order's client_id with the caller's company

regression_test.description: Client B GETs client A's order id and expects 403/404

title: A client can list customer records via the admin endpoint
summary: GET /api/admin/customers returns 200 for every client role; only admins should see customers. Records may contain personal data.
steps: Sign in as acme-1 over the API
GET /api/admin/customers
Observe HTTP 200 (the role matrix in the admin-base run shows 200 for acme-1, acme-2, bright-1 and zain-1; reports endpoint correctly returns 403)
suspected_cause: Missing admin role check on the customers route

regression_test.description: Each client role GETs /admin/customers and expects 403

title: Sign-out does not revoke the session token
summary: After POST /auth/logout returns 204, the same token still works on GET /me.
steps: Sign in as zain-1 over the API
POST /api/auth/logout (204)
GET /api/me with the same token
Observe HTTP 200
suspected_cause: Logout does not add the token to a revocation list

regression_test.description: Log out then call /me with the same token; expect 401

title: Tax is charged on the undiscounted subtotal, so totals are too high
summary: With the 5% discount applied, tax is still 10% of the full subtotal. A 1,000.00 order totals $1,050.00 instead of $1,045.00. The Client and Admin portals show the same wrong total.
steps: Sign in as acme-1 over the API
POST /api/orders with 80 x p-102 (12.50 each, subtotal 1,000.00)
Observe discount 50.00, tax 100.00, total 1,050.00; expected tax 95.00 and total 1,045.00
Also seen in the UI: Client Portal > New order, 80 x Ballpoint Pens, confirmation says Total: $1,050.00 (screenshot)
expected: tax = 10% of (subtotal - discount): 95.00; total 1,045.00 (81 x p-102 expects 1,058.06; 1000 x p-101 expects 6,792.50)
suspected_cause: Tax computed from subtotal instead of the discounted subtotal

regression_test.description: Order of 80 x 12.50 expects tax 9500 and total 104500 cents

title: Quantity limits and empty orders are not enforced
summary: POST /api/orders returns 201 for quantity 0, -3, 1001 and 1.5, and for an empty items list. A negative quantity creates an order with a negative total (-$21.45).
steps: Sign in as acme-1 over the API
POST /api/orders with items[0].quantity = -3 (see totals-T6)
Repeat with quantity 0, 1001, 1.5 and items [] (client-base P043-P046)
Observe HTTP 201 each time
expected: HTTP 400: quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 1000; at least one item

regression_test.description: Table test for invalid quantities and empty items expecting 400

title: Order list returns 500 for page_size=0 and for q=( or q=\
summary: GET /api/orders crashes with HTTP 500 on page_size=0 and on search text containing regex characters (likely used unescaped in a regular expression). page_size=-1 returns 200 with page_size -1 instead of 400.
steps: Sign in as acme-1 over the API
GET /api/orders?page_size=0, then ?q=( , then ?q=\
Observe HTTP 500 each time
expected: HTTP 400 for invalid page_size; search treats text literally
suspected_cause: Unescaped search string and unvalidated page_size

regression_test.description: GET /orders with page_size=0 and q='(' must not return 5xx

title: Malformed JSON errors expose stack traces and server file paths
summary: Sending malformed JSON to POST /auth/login or POST /orders returns 400 with a stack trace and source paths in the body.
steps: POST /api/auth/login with body {bad (see evidence)
Repeat for POST /api/orders as acme-1
Observe a stack field and file paths in the error body
expected: A short error message without internals
actual: Stack trace and server paths in the response

regression_test.description: Malformed JSON returns 400 whose body has no 'stack' field or paths

title: Double-submitted orders are both created
summary: Two identical POST /orders sent at once both return 201 and both appear in My Orders (e.g. two QA-t80, two QA-tneg). Unsure whether duplicates are intended, but a double click would charge a client twice.
steps: Sign in as acme-1 over the API
Send the same POST /orders twice in parallel (client-base P049)
Observe 201 twice and two identical rows in the order list
expected: One order, or a clear duplicate warning
suspected_cause: No idempotency key or duplicate check

regression_test.description: Parallel identical POSTs create at most one order

title: Client Portal My Orders on mobile: toolbar covers the table header and first row, columns cut off
summary: At 390px the Status filter/New order toolbar overlaps the table header and first row; the Total and View columns are cut off inside a sideways-scrolling box with no visible cue.
steps: Sign in to the Client Portal as acme-1
Resize to 390x844
Open My orders
Observe the header row hidden under the toolbar, the first order partly covered, totals truncated and no View link visible
expected: Table sits below the toolbar; totals and View reachable
actual: Overlap and clipped columns (audit coveredElements, reproduced after fresh load)

regression_test.description: Visual check of My orders at 390px: no covered elements

title: Sales report is slow (about 4 s) and shows only a heading while loading
summary: GET /admin/reports/sales takes about 4 seconds each time; the Reports page is empty with no loading indicator until it returns.
steps: Sign in as admin
Open Admin Portal > Reports and read the page straight away
Or GET /api/admin/reports/sales and note the time
expected: Under 3 s, or a loading message

regression_test.description: Sales report responds in under 3 s

title: Urdu-language client sees left-aligned pages with no RTL direction
summary: For the Urdu tenant, Urdu order references render in a left-to-right container (html has no dir, lang is en); the audit flags them.
steps: Sign in to the Client Portal as zain-1
Open My orders (1366x768)
Observe Urdu references left-aligned in LTR cells; reload and repeat
expected: Urdu text shown with correct direction/alignment
actual: All content LTR (mixed digits and Urdu in references read in LTR order)

regression_test.description: Cells with Urdu text use dir=auto

title: New order product dropdown has no accessible name
summary: The product select on New order has no label, so screen readers announce only 'combobox'.
steps: Sign in as acme-1
Open New order
Run the audit or inspect the snapshot: unnamedControls lists select[name=product]
expected: Select has a label or aria-label

regression_test.description: Every select on New order has an accessible name
